name: Cabriole Leg for a Lacquered Table Top (one of two)
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；probably 1st century CE；Gilt bronze.  Probably made in Sichuan province; probably recovered at Lelang (also spelled Lo-lang; Korean, Naknang), near T'o-sông-ni, southwest of P'yôngyang, Korea.
